blocks.text: From teargas in Paris to gen Z in Germany: protests across Europe – in pictures
Demonstrations over the high cost of living and inequality spread from France to Germany and Albania
A protester stands next to police officers during a nationwide protest by campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen Z takes charge) in Cologne, Germany. Photograph: Thilo Schmülgen/Reuters

A protester waves a French flag amid teargas smoke while taking part in a nationwide demonstration over the rising cost of living and inequality organised by the gilets jaunes (Yellow Vest) movement, labour unions and high school and university students, in Lyon, France Photograph: Jeff Pachoud/AFP/Getty Images
A protester dressed as the Joker in handcuffs in Paris amid an ‘exceptional’ security deployment with 70,000 police officers and gendarmes mobilisedPhotograph: Sameer Al-Doumy/AFP/Getty Images

A protester with a Statue of Liberty hat and fake blood on his hands stands next to police officers during a nationwide protest by campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen Z takes charge) in Cologne, GermanyPhotograph: Thilo Schmülgen/Reuters
Flames rise after a petrol bomb lands next to a police water cannon truck during an anti-government protest in Tirana, AlbaniaPhotograph: Florion Goga/Reuters
A woman poses with a ‘Gen Z takes care of it’ placard in front of the Brandenburg Gate during a protest in Berlin, GermanyPhotograph: Ebrahim Noroozi/AP
